Lowest cos_min among P1 (0.648); reference coverage 9%; validity = mixed. It has the most near-duplicate partners (5), which is typical of a noise sink.

T0239.secondary: Near-duplicates T0181 Layout and Spatial Design (0.914) and T0193 Painting and Art (0.907). The rule-based 'coherent' result and this recommendation disagree; a human should decide.
